stops.note: meant 'bird', later becoming the name of a Peruvian valley and its potter inhabitants
became the name of the Peruvian port town where the grape brandy was shipped from
stops.meaning: a port city in Peru; later the brandy exported from it

stops.note: borrowed into English to name the South American grape brandy
stops.meaning: a clear grape brandy distilled in Peru and Chile

current_meaning: a clear grape brandy produced in Peru and Chile, traditionally used in the pisco sour cocktail
